instruction: A candid and joyful studio photograph of two friends embracing. On the left, the woman in the distressed denim jacket (R1) wraps her arms around her friend's waist, laughing heartily with her eyes closed and head tilted back. On the right, the woman in the blue-and-white striped off-the-shoulder top (R2) holds her close, smiling brightly with her teeth showing directly at the camera. The medium shot at eye level captures them from the waist up against a solid, vibrant red background. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting that casts soft shadows, highlighting their joyful interaction and the vivid red backdrop.
elements: R1 wraps her arms around R2's waist
R1 laughs with her eyes closed and head tilted back during the contact
R2 holds R1 close while smiling directly at the camera
R2 is the camera-facing smiling participant while R1 is the laughing, head-tilted participant
